title: Evaluating Subjective Cognitive Appraisals of Emotions from Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating large language models (LLMs) on their ability to assess and explain cognitive appraisals of emotions, which are subjective evaluations of situations based on an individual's values. While "consistency with internal values" is one of the appraisal dimensions assessed for the human narrator, the paper does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of LLMs on religious, moral, or ethical principles, reasoning, or content generation in a broader sense. The ethical considerations or limitations are not a core component of the evaluation.
